original_frontmatter.name: phaser-core
original_frontmatter.description: Sets up and debugs Phaser 4 games (and pinned Phaser 3.90): Game config, Scene lifecycle, the loader, scene transitions and Phaser 3 to 4 migration. Use when code imports phaser, or on a black screen, assets undefined in create, or a HUD scene behind the game. Not for colliders (`phaser-arcade-physics`), HUD layout (`game-ui-ux`) or PixiJS (`pixijs-rendering`).
